description: Writes 1 to 3 short, polite sentences for a traveller to say to the airline agent, asking for re-routing, care or a refund. The sentences are in the traveller's language and cite the regulation that applies.

arrival_delay_minutes.description: Expected arrival delay at the final destination, in minutes.

carrier.description: IATA code of the operating airline, for example FR, W6 or OS.

cause.description: Reason given by the airline, if known.

departure_delay_minutes.description: Departure delay in minutes, if different from the arrival delay.

destination.description: IATA code of the final destination on the booking, for example LHR.

lang.description: Traveller's language for any text meant to be read out or copied. Defaults to en.

notice_days.description: Cancellations: days between the notice and scheduled departure.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, for example VIE.

overnight.description: True if the traveller must stay overnight.

reroute_arrives_later_minutes.description: Re-routing offered: how many minutes later it arrives than the original flight.

reroute_departs_earlier_minutes.description: Re-routing offered: how many minutes earlier it departs than the original flight.

single_booking.description: Missed connections: were all flights on one booking?

volunteered.description: Denied boarding: did the traveller volunteer?

name: sos_desk_script
title: What to say at the airline desk
